behavioral_notes.observation: On lot/serial creation when product.use_expiration_date is set, expiration_date = now + product_tmpl.expiration_time (days); use_date, removal_date and alert_date are then derived by subtracting product_tmpl.use_time/removal_time/alert_time from expiration_date. These four lot dates are computed in Python from the product template lead-times, not stored as static metadata.

Adds the 'fefo' removal strategy: when active, reservation ordering becomes 'removal_date, in_date, id', i.e. First-Expiry-First-Out (oldest removal_date picked first). stock.move._update_reserved_quantity/_get_available_quantity inject a with_expiration context so reservation respects expiry; stock.quant._compute_available_quantity zeroes available_quantity once removal_date is past.

On validating a delivery, _check_expired_lots flags move lines whose lot is expired (product_expiry_alert) or whose removal_date has passed and pops the expiry.picking.confirmation wizard. The user can confirm delivery of expired goods (process) or strip the expired move lines and proceed (process_no_expired). Side-effect not visible in metadata.

Scheduled job: searches internally-stored lots with alert_date <= today and product_expiry_reminded=False, schedules a mail.activity (To Do) on the product responsible, then sets product_expiry_reminded=True so each lot is reminded once. Drives the proactive expiry-alert workflow.

2 JS files patch the stock Forecasted (replenishment) report client-side: lines are sorted by removal_date and 'Free Stock' lines without an expiry have the to-remove quantity subtracted, surfacing fresh-vs-expiring stock in the OWL report. UI-only behavior, no models added.

information_flows: side-effect: stock.lot creation -> expiration_date/use_date/removal_date/alert_date computed from product.template lead-times
side-effect: stock.picking validation -> expiry.picking.confirmation wizard when delivering expired/past-removal lots
side-effect: stock.quant FEFO removal strategy -> reservation ordered by removal_date (first-expiry-first-out)
side-effect: stock.lot._alert_date_exceeded cron -> mail.activity (To Do) on product responsible

capabilities: Track Product Expiration Dates (end-of-life / best-before / removal / alert)
value_streams: Perishable inventory lifecycle: receipt/production -> dated lot -> FEFO reservation -> expiry alert -> remove or deliver-with-confirmation
policies: FEFO removal ordering (removal_date, in_date, id) when strategy = fefo
Past-removal_date stock excluded from available/fresh quantity
Delivery of expired lots requires explicit wizard confirmation
alert_date cron reminds product responsible once per lot
metrics: Fresh On Hand vs to-remove quantity (Forecasted/replenishment report)

classification.rationale: product_expiry is a lean support extension of the inventory/logistics leg of the value chain (Stabell & Fjeldstad: a manufacturing/distribution firm is a value chain; warehousing is its inbound/outbound logistics). It adds expiration dating, the FEFO removal strategy and expiry alerting onto stock's lots/quants/moves without introducing its own process or routes, so it augments the chain's stock rather than constituting a primary activity. Maps to APQC 4.3.2 Manage logistics and warehousing / inventory management.

standard_capabilities: Per-lot/serial expiration, best-before, removal and alert dates auto-computed from product lead-times
Expiry alerts via scheduled activity on the product responsible
Confirmation wizard when delivering expired or past-removal stock
Expiration dates on delivery slips / lot barcodes (GS1 AI 15/17)
typical_fits: Food, pharma and cosmetics perishable inventory with shelf-life dating
Warehouses needing FEFO picking instead of FIFO
Operations requiring an explicit guard before shipping expired goods
common_gaps: Quarantine / disposal workflow for removed stock (not provided)
Industry-specific date rules (lot-level overrides, partial-batch expiry)
Hard block (vs. confirm) on shipping expired stock requires customization
Regulatory traceability/recall reporting beyond the alert activity
